items.description: Installable software (currently private beta) to help you learn more about your community thanks to different search criteria and filters that can be applied to your followers and friends. SocialBro's technology allows you to download all your community to your PC and browse them even if you are offline. SocialBro will be available as an Adobe Air desktop application and as a Google Chrome App.

Amazon CloudWatch is a web service that provides visibility into your cloud assets. Amazon CloudWatch provides the data you need to make informed decisions. It is designed to provide comprehensive monitoring for all of the following AWS services: Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud or Amazon EC2 (including instances of paid AMIs), and Elastic Load Balancing.
Service that provides a platform to create a geotagged photo album.
A fun and educational way to track the status of U.S. legislation, highlighting the actual locations where law gets made.
650+ data series from the Federal Reserve, US economic data in a navigable timeline with landmark events.
This shows photos of Flickr in Google Maps API Interface, not on map. You can search by tag, text and username.
WikiMapia is a project to describe the whole planet Earth. Done as a community-built geographic WikiPedia. Just move the map to find interesting places, click on rectangles, create your own.
Video classifieds site that connects the local community and assists sellers and buyers in making transactions via videos.

From their site: The BeenVerified.com API follows the OAuth protocol and gives developers the ability to provide more trustworthy environments for their users, while even further enhancing user privacy and security.
This mashup allows users to enter a US address and returns a map of the address point within the ZIP Code polygon.
Enter your zip code to find Social Security offices nearest you.

Kukunu is a new travel planning experience that simplifies the life of travellers around the world. Travelers can collaborate to create their itinerary then add transports, hotels, restaurants, activities and sights across the cities they plan to visit.
